## [From the moment I saw a couch I loved…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a1ca4566dba0561259846cc)
From the moment I saw a couch I loved in an ad 6 months ago in Real Simple magazine to the final delivery of our furniture yesterday, it’s been the best customer service experience! I ordered a fabric swatch and then had a few emails about the couch I was considering. We bought a new house and needed living room furniture. Everyone that assisted with this was so pleasant and easy to work with! And not pushy at all! I had an email the middle of May announcing that I could view your Memorial Day sale early so I worked with Vanessa to help me pick out a chair and coffee table to go with the couch. Ordering was easy and efficient! The timeline from ordering to scheduling delivery was amazing and the the delivery service was excellent! The value of your pieces is amazing! We are so happy with everything! Thank you, 

Mary Jo O’Neal

Fort Mill, SC

May 19, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 1, 2026

Hi Mary Jo,

We are so happy to hear about your wonderful experience with us, from finding your perfect couch to the final delivery. We truly appreciate your kind words, and are delighted you are happy with everything.

Lulu and Georgia
